text_simplified: This text discusses the rights of children upon their parents, drawing evidence from the Qur'an and Prophetic hadiths. It clarifies that among the child’s rights is that their parents provide them with good *tarbiyah* (upbringing and nurturing) and education. It also highlights the importance of providing care and love to children.
